title: Australian Fish Bake
description: A simple and delicious fish bake recipe, inspired by Australian flavors, featuring a nourishing and cheesy twist.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Rinse the cod fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Brush the cod fillets with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the cod fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Mix the Australian bush tomato sauce, shredded cheese, chopped parsley, and minced garlic in a bowl.
Spoon the sauce mixture evenly over the cod fillets.
Place a lemon wedge on top of each cod fillet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and the cheese is golden brown.
